accent.customDetail: Any #rrggbb color, shown while you type
accent.inactive: Cool Islands is not the current color theme: the accent is seen once Cool Islands Dark or Light is selected.
accent.placeholder: Each accent is shown as you move to it. Enter keeps it, Escape goes back.

colors.reload: The colors of {{theme}} changed with the color themes mixed in. Reload the window to see them.

confirmReload: You have to restart VS Code to activate the changes to the icons.

diagnostics.copied: The diagnostics of Cool Theme Kit are in the clipboard: paste them into the bug report. Read them first: the settings can contain file and folder names.

fonts.missing: The editor uses the fonts of the JetBrains IDEs, but these are not installed: {{fonts}}. Until then, the editor uses the next font of the list.
fonts.notUsed: The user settings have no JetBrains fonts of Cool Theme Kit to remove.
fonts.offer: Cool Islands goes with the fonts of the JetBrains IDEs: JetBrains Mono in the editor, with Korean fonts for Hangul. Write them to your user settings? "Stop Using the JetBrains Fonts" removes them.
fonts.removed: The JetBrains fonts were removed from the user settings: the editor uses its own font again.
fonts.replaceQuestion: Replace the fonts of your user settings ({{fonts}}) with the JetBrains fonts?

oldExtension.found: Cool Theme Kit moved to a new extension id, and the old one (woogajjangka.cool-icon-vscode) is still installed: both give the same settings and themes. Uninstall the old one? Your settings stay.
oldExtension.removed: The old Cool Theme Kit extension is uninstalled.

opacity.wrongValue: The value must be between 0 and 1!

outdatedVersion: You have to update VS Code to use this command.

preset.applied: The theme combination {{name}} is applied. The mixed colors and icons are seen after a reload of the window.

profiles.conflict: Cool Theme Kit generated its theme files again for this profile: another VS Code profile had generated them with other values of {{settings}}. All the profiles share the theme files of the extension, so profiles with other values overwrite each other's theme at every start.
profiles.share: Use This Profile's Settings in All Profiles
profiles.shared: The theme settings of Cool Theme Kit are now shared by all the profiles (workbench.settings.applyToAllProfiles), with the values of this profile.

readOnly.message: Cool Theme Kit cannot write in its own folder ({{folder}}). The default themes keep working, but the settings that change them (icon settings, accent color, mixed themes) are not applied while the folder is read-only.

saturation.wrongValue: The value must be between 0 and 1!

themeInstalled: Cool Theme Kit has been installed.

themeMixer.accentHint: Replaces the blue of Cool Islands (focus ring, buttons, links, active tab, selection). It wins over the layers, and a key below wins over it. It is shown at once while you pick it; the theme files follow, and a reload of the window makes it final.
themeMixer.byNameHint: The theme giving the icon of a file name, an extension (*.ext) or a folder (name/). It wins over the layers. Cool Icons gives a name its own icon back, over an override layer. Click an icon in the preview to set one.
themeMixer.colorByKeyHint: Single colors from a theme, over the layers: a workbench color id or a glob of them (terminal.*), scope:<TextMate scope> or semantic:<selector>. A later key wins over an earlier one.
themeMixer.colorInactive: Cool Islands is not the current color theme: the result is what it shows once selected (Preferences: Color Theme).
themeMixer.colorLayersHint: Other installed color themes mixed with Cool Islands, for the workbench colors and the syntax colors separately. Fill: only what Cool Islands has no color for. Override: that theme wins (for the syntax, its syntax colors replace the ones of Cool Islands). The first listed wins. A theme mixes into the Cool Islands theme of its own kind.
themeMixer.colorPreviewHint: Workbench colors and a line of code in the result, in Cool Islands alone and in each theme mixed in. VS Code shows the new colors after a reload of the window.
themeMixer.inactive: Cool Icons is not the current file icon theme: the result is what it shows once selected (Preferences: File Icon Theme).
themeMixer.layersHint: Other installed icon themes mixed with Cool Icons. Fill: only the names Cool Icons has no icon for. Override: every name the theme has an icon for. The first listed wins.
themeMixer.name: Name
themeMixer.noByName: No name has its own theme.
themeMixer.noColorByKey: No key has its own theme.
themeMixer.noColorLayers: No other theme is mixed: Cool Islands only.
themeMixer.noColorThemes: No other color theme is installed.
themeMixer.noLayers: No other theme is mixed: Cool Icons only.
themeMixer.noProductByName: No icon has its own theme.
themeMixer.noProductLayers: No other theme is mixed: Cool Islands Icons only.
themeMixer.noProductThemes: No other product icon theme is installed.
themeMixer.noThemes: No other file icon theme is installed.
themeMixer.presetsHint: Ready-made combinations of the settings below, with a preview.
themeMixer.previewHint: Result: the icon shown in the explorer. The other columns: the icon of each installed theme. Click one to use it for that name, click it again to stop.
themeMixer.productByNameHint: The theme giving single icons, over the layers: an icon id or a glob of them (debug-*). A later entry wins over an earlier one.
themeMixer.productInactive: Cool Islands Icons is not the current product icon theme: the result is what it shows once selected (Preferences: Product Icon Theme).
themeMixer.productLayersHint: Other installed product icon themes mixed with Cool Islands Icons (the JetBrains New UI icons). Fill: only the icons Cool Islands Icons has none for. Override: every icon the theme has. The first listed wins.
themeMixer.productPreviewHint: Common icons of the workbench in the result, in Cool Islands Icons alone and in each theme mixed in. –: the VS Code icon. VS Code shows the new icons after a reload of the window.
themeMixer.samplesHint: One per line; a folder ends with /.
themeMixer.title: Mix Themes

themeUpdated: Cool Theme Kit has been updated.
